title: Sign-off
description: The professional's sign-off: who prepared the report, the certification (a tick-box choice or one statement), and the lines signed by hand. Never fills a seal, a signature or a date.

rows.description: The preparer's rows, as via-fields takes them.

choices.description: Certification as tick boxes: the options, none ticked; or null.

statement.description: Certification as one fixed statement; or null.

lines.description: The lines signed by hand, in order.

toComplete.description: What the sign-off leaves to complete, in its own words.
